description_en: Asynchronously deletes a knowledge base. Verifies the trusted tenant identity, workspace ownership, and access permissions for the knowledge base. If the resource is already in the Deleting or Deleted state, repeated deletion requests return the current state without re-initiating cleanup. After the deletion is accepted, GetKnowledgeBase indicates that the resource does not exist, and ListKnowledgeBases no longer displays the resource. The system continues to clean up physical data in the background
description_zh: 异步删除知识库。先校验可信租户身份、工作空间归属及知识库访问权限；若资源已为 Deleting 或 Deleted，重复删除返回当前状态，不重复发起清理。删除受理后，GetKnowledgeBase 返回资源不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 不再显示该资源；后台继续清理物理数据
name: DeleteKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en: Resolves the tenant ID from the trusted gateway through Magic and verifies workspace ownership. A knowledge base is created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. Cross-tenant queries are not supported by using only the knowledge base ID
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

data.description_en: Returns the knowledge base details when a deletion request is accepted. If you repeatedly delete a resource that is in the Deleting or Deleted state, the current state is returned without initiating the cleanup process again. GetKnowledgeBase returns a resource not found error for deleted resources, and ListKnowledgeBases excludes the resource. The backend continues asynchronous cleanup. A successful response does not indicate that physical data cleanup is complete
data.description_zh: 返回删除受理时的知识库详情；重复删除处于 Deleting 或 Deleted 的资源时返回当前状态，不重复发起清理。GetKnowledgeBase 对已删除资源返回不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 排除该资源；后台继续异步清理，返回不表示物理数据已清理完成

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The valid configuration with default values resolved. It only affects subsequently uploaded or explicitly reprocessed assets
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析默认值的有效配置，仅影响后续新上传或显式重新处理的资产

headingLevel.description_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING. Valid values: 1 to 6. Headings at or below this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence splitting. Documents without headings fall back to intelligent splitting. It is ignored for other strategies and verified by the backend based on the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: 1 to 6,000 characters. It follows the character length metric of EB and is not the number of tokens. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. A valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize. The length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk length. It is ignored for other strategies and verified by the backend based on the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules before splitting
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole without using regular expressions. It is ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: Returns the saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for compatibility with historical configurations. Only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted when you create or update a configuration in the first phase
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

createdAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

embeddingDimension.description_en: The vector dimensions that actually take effect. Default value: 1024. It cannot be modified after creation
embeddingDimension.description_zh: 实际生效的向量维度，默认 1024，创建后不可修改

embeddingModel.description_en: The name of the model that actually takes effect. It cannot be modified after creation. Default value: text-embedding-v4
embeddingModel.description_zh: 实际生效的模型名称，创建后不可修改；默认 text-embedding-v4

enumValueTitles.qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash: 通义文本向量极速模型 3.7（qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v3: 通义文本向量模型 v3（text-embedding-v3）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v4: 通义文本向量模型 v4（text-embedding-v4）

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable knowledge base ID generated by the platform. It is persistently bound to the tenantId and workspaceId. Queries and modifications must verify all three identifiers simultaneously. Access based solely on the ID is not allowed
knowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 平台生成的稳定知识库 ID，持久化绑定 tenantId 和 workspaceId；查询和变更必须同时校验三者，不得仅凭 ID 访问

lastError.description_en: The sanitized error summary when a lifecycle operation fails
lastError.description_zh: 生命周期操作失败时的脱敏错误摘要

code.description_en: The stable product error code. It does not return internal task identifiers, stack traces, or storage addresses
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The sanitized error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadataSchema.description_en: The metadata schema is determined during creation and cannot be modified after creation. It includes constant or system variable configurations
metadataSchema.description_zh: 创建时确定，创建后不可修改；包含常量或系统变量配置

name.description_en: The name of the metadata field for the knowledge base in the workspace. It must be unique within the same schema and must not occupy system-controlled fields
name.description_zh: 工作空间内知识库的元数据字段名；同一 schema 中唯一，不得占用系统控制字段

type.description_en: The field type, which can be STRING, LONG, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, or DATETIME. Uploaded and updated string values are parsed by the backend based on this type. Nested objects are not accepted
type.description_zh: STRING、LONG、DOUBLE、BOOLEAN 或 DATETIME。上传和更新的字符串 value 由后端按此类型解析；不接受嵌套对象

value.description_en: The fixed value or system variable name. The following variables are retained: DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_URI, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME. DOCUMENT_* refers to the original asset in this API operation, and the variable names are retained for EB compatibility
value.description_zh: 固定值或系统变量名。沿用 DOCUMENT_NAME、FILE_TYPE、FILE_SIZE、DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME、SOURCE_TYPE、SOURCE_URI、SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME；DOCUMENT_* 在本接口中指资产原件，变量名保留 EB 兼容性

valueMode.description_en: The value mode. CONSTANT indicates a constant: a fixed value is used when the value is not empty, and the value is assigned during upload when no value is configured. SYSTEM_VARIABLE indicates that the value is generated by the system and cannot be overwritten by customers. The schema cannot be modified after creation
valueMode.description_zh: CONSTANT 表示常量：value 非空时使用固定值，未配置值时由上传赋值；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 表示由系统生成，客户不得覆盖。schema 创建后不可修改

name.description_en: The display name of the knowledge base

regionId.description_en: The region where the knowledge base is located. It is consistent with the workspace to which it belongs and is maintained by the server
regionId.description_zh: 知识库所在地域，与所属工作空间一致，由服务端维护

searchConfiguration.description_en: The valid search configuration with platform default values resolved. It can be overridden by a single search request
searchConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析平台默认值的有效检索配置，可由单次检索请求覆盖

mode.description_en: KEYWORD indicates keyword retrieval, VECTOR indicates vector retrieval, and HYBRID indicates hybrid retrieval. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, HYBRID is used
mode.description_zh: KEYWORD 为关键词检索，VECTOR 为向量检索，HYBRID 为混合检索。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 HYBRID

rankAlgorithm.description_en: RRF indicates reciprocal rank fusion, and WEIGHTED indicates weighted normalization fusion. It takes effect only for HYBRID. The system default is RRF
rankAlgorithm.description_zh: RRF 为倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 为加权归一融合。仅 HYBRID 生效，系统默认 RRF

rerankEnabled.description_en: Applies to all three search modes. It is overridden when explicitly specified in the request. If neither is configured, the value is false
rerankEnabled.description_zh: 适用于三种检索模式；请求显式指定时覆盖本配置，均未配置时为 false

rerankModel.description_en: Supports qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. The request configuration takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, qwen3-rerank is used
rerankModel.description_zh: 支持 qwen3-rerank、qwen3.7-text-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank；请求优先于本配置，均未配置时使用 qwen3-rerank

enumValueTitles.gte-rerank-v2: 通用文本重排模型 v2（gte-rerank-v2）

rrfK.description_en: The k parameter for RRF. The system default is 60. It must be greater than 0
rrfK.description_zh: RRF 的 k 参数，系统默认 60，必须大于 0

topK.description_en: A maximum of 100 results are returned. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, 10 is used. The actual number of results may be less than this value after permission and release version filtering
topK.description_zh: 最多返回 100 条。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 10；权限和发布版本过滤后可能不足该数量

vectorWeight.description_en: The vector path weight for WEIGHTED. The system default is 0.7. The keyword path weight is 1 minus this value
vectorWeight.description_zh: WEIGHTED 的向量路权重，系统默认 0.7，关键词路权重为 1 减去此值

status.description_en: You can use GetKnowledgeBase and ListKnowledgeBases to query the creation progress. Creating indicates that the creation is in progress, Active indicates that the creation is successful, and CreateFailed indicates that the creation failed. A deletion acceptance response may return Deleting, DeleteFailed, or Deleted. After a deletion request is accepted, GetKnowledgeBase returns a resource not found error, ListKnowledgeBases no longer displays the resource, and the backend continues the cleanup process. For the cause of a creation failure, see lastError
status.description_zh: GetKnowledgeBase 和 ListKnowledgeBases 可查询创建进度：Creating 为创建中，Active 为创建成功，CreateFailed 为创建失败。删除受理响应可返回 Deleting、DeleteFailed 或 Deleted；删除受理后 GetKnowledgeBase 返回资源不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 不再显示该资源，后台继续清理。创建失败原因见 lastError

tenantId.description_en: The read-only tenant ownership. It is resolved by Magic based on the trusted gateway call identity and bound during creation. It is consistent with the tenant of the workspace to which the resource belongs. Client-specified or modified values are not accepted
tenantId.description_zh: 只读租户归属，由 Magic 根据可信网关调用身份解析并在创建时绑定，与所属工作空间的租户一致；不接受客户端指定或修改

updatedAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The AgentCore workspace to which the resource belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
